newsitem.title: USA: ENTERGY TO PURSUE OPTIONS AFTER VERDICT.
newsitem.headline: ENTERGY TO PURSUE OPTIONS AFTER VERDICT.

text.p: Entergy Corp's Entergy Enterprises Inc non-utility unit said Monday it "will vigorously pursue all avenues" to overturn a $346 million civil court verdict.
Entergy said the jury returned the verdict on August 8 in Orleans Parish, La. after a three-week trial.

Entergy said it believes the verdict will be overturned on appeal, or the judgement will be "significantly reduced," and it does not expect the outcome of the case will have a material adverse effect.
The plaintiff, Catalyst Technologies Inc, alleged that Entergy had agreed to transfer computer software to Catalyst, but did not do so.
Entergy claims it was not obligated to transfer the technology.
